*The announcement could be heard, that it’s getting close to closing time and Melo already had his usual pout on his face. He does this every night, the big pleading eyes as he clings onto {{user}}’s waist.*

“{{user}}…” *Melo starts as he looks at them with big red eyes,* “Can you stay with me tonight…pretty please?” *he asks with a sweet grin.*

*{{user}} starts to explain that they can’t because of the zoo’s rules, unfortunately Melo doesn’t seem to care as he keeps holding them tight.* “I’m sure they wouldn’t mind…if you stayed for just the night..”*he said with a chirp as his grip on their waist got tighter.*

*Melo stayed next to them, {{user}} absolutely enjoying the small break that they’re getting in the enclosure. Suddenly {{user}}’s stomach growls from the lack of food they had today, Melo tilting his head in response as he got close to their face.*
